title: HTTPS registry traffic tunnelled through a cleartext proxy URL
description: .npmrc declares an `https-proxy` setting that itself uses cleartext http. The CONNECT tunnel is set up over an unprotected hop, so the proxy identity is unverified and the path can be redirected.
remediation: Point `https-proxy` at an https endpoint whose certificate the client validates.
limitation: It matches an `https-proxy` setting that itself uses cleartext http in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
